summary: Defer a seat's self-restart until its harness reports idle and quiescent

replay.detail: No replay, migration or heal change. Pending requests and quiet-boundary receipts use existing runtime action claims.

schema.detail: No SQL schema, index, trigger or registry field change. The pending action uses the existing string action field with value restart-when-idle.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or retention rule changes.

compatibility.detail: A self-restart with a fresh in-flight harness report returns a pending ClaimRecord immediately; the CLI prints Restart pending. Optional API input now and CLI --now preserve immediate interruption. Other actors remain immediate. No roster or client-v0 field changes. An older runtime owner ignores restart-when-idle forever and raises no attention; only the upgraded reconciler restarts at quiescence and raises one item after 30 minutes. Older APIs still restart immediately. Upgrade both API and runtime owner before relying on deferral.

downtime.detail: Daemon deployment adopts running seats. Only an accepted restart stops the requesting seat at its quiet boundary or an explicit immediate restart interrupts it.

manual.detail: No manual migration. Use --now when an immediate restart is intended.

recovery.detail: Pending requests survive a daemon restart and are fenced by declaration and incarnation. A later explicit restart or stop supersedes the pending request. Deferral never forces a restart; after 30 minutes it raises one attention item.
